title: Destroy All Monsters Magazine 1976–1979

description.main: Facsimile edition of Destroy All Monsters Magazine, with remnants of a lost seventh issue, edited by Cary Loren and reprinted in full by Primary Information in 2011.
description.extended:
A complete facsimile of Destroy All Monsters Magazine, the zine the band Destroy All Monsters produced from 1976 to 1979, reprinted in full for the first time.

Primary Information issued the 270-page paperback in June 2011, with 40 color and 185 black-and-white images. It includes remnants of a seventh issue that was never released. Cary Loren edited the magazine, which carries artwork, photographs and flyers by Loren, Mike Kelley, Niagara and Jim Shaw. The band printed on whatever papers and techniques were available, and the pages combine the cut-and-paste methods of punk zines with a fondness for psychedelic color: movie imagery, kitsch, cartoons, drawings and collage.

Kelley, Loren, Niagara and Shaw were the band's members, and the magazine is a record of their shared visual language. James Hoff was managing editor of the reprint and Karma managing designer. The band has been the subject of recent exhibitions and partial reprints, but this edition is the first to reproduce every issue.

notes: Trade edition; a separate signed limited edition also exists. Reproduces all issues plus remnants of an unreleased seventh.
